verdict.rationale: Statsig docs reference Dynamic Configs alongside Feature Gates and Experiments (e.g., statsig-docs-9, statsig-docs-10, statsig-docs-11, statsig-docs-31 mention 'Dynamic Configs' as a managed entity distinct from booleans), and experiments/layers imply multivariate parameter delivery (statsig-docs-4, statsig-docs-26, statsig-docs-30). However, no evidence explicitly confirms support for strings/numbers/JSON value types or shows a dynamic config JSON payload example. missing for 10: explicit documentation or example showing dynamic config value types (string/number/JSON), SDK code sample retrieving a non-boolean config value.
